key_value_text.value: A parity-violating asymmetry of 50 standard deviations in the distribution of decay electrons relative to the muon spin

name: Observations of the Failure of Conservation of Parity and Charge Conjugation in Meson Decays: the Magnetic Moment of the Free Muon
notes: The paper title says "Observations"; typed observation per A16.

summary.plain: Garwin, Lederman and Weinrich showed that when a pion decays to a muon and the muon decays to an electron, the electrons come out preferentially in one direction relative to the muon spin. Nature distinguishes left from right in these weak decays.
summary.technical: Large decay-electron asymmetry from polarized, stopped mu+ at the Nevis cyclotron; parity and charge-conjugation invariance both fail in pi → mu → e decay; g(μ⁺) = +2.00 ± 0.10.

title: Observations of the Failure of Conservation of Parity and Charge Conjugation in Meson Decays: the Magnetic Moment of the Free Muon
why_it_matters: Lederman: this large effect "established the two-component neutrinos" and, with details of the decay parameters, "the V-A structure of the weak interactions".
